text: Commissioned 2026-08-29 05:47Z from the ratification at post-01M160WXB04D5HB6FXC9Z9XX47. Draft an ADR section recording the estimand carrier law. THE ARCHITECTURAL DECISION: yes to a shared RULE, no to one universal carrier type - Distribution, ExpectedCount+interval, hard classification, conditional ratio, graph rate and scalar projection have different lawful algebras, and forcing them through one wrapper would erase the distinctions the project exists to preserve. THE SIX PROPERTIES: (1) decompose attributed/resolved from excluded/unresolved mass, never conflate; (2) the public result returns estimate AND its condition/support together and every downstream projection and codec preserves both - the enforceable form is 'library APIs never discard the support on the caller's behalf', NOT 'extraction is impossible', since a field is always extractable in Scala; (3) never renormalize residue unless the estimand is explicitly conditional and named so; (4) support/coverage is first-class and uses the estimand's own grain and reducer, not a borrowed integer count; (5) no eligible trial means Missing - never an optimal or worst numeric default (evidence: false-gating scored 0.0 on an unexercised gate; RecallSignature reported perfect chronology and coherence on zero route trials); (6) carrier law is explicit per carrier - subprobability conserves mass, missing count widens bounds, hard classification abstains, projections propagate support. Cite the instances: unresolved placement as external detail, unranked mass in externalMass, absent admissibility as gate compliance, zero-trial chronology, and the renormalization trap in the naive repair. Announce the hunk on coordination per rule 4, keep it paragraph-disjoint, post as its own candidate; chief ratifies before landing. You have the largest sample and found five of the instances.
